reviews.title: diminished default accuracy
reviews.text: This is my go-to weather app, far better than everything else available - however - MeteoBlueAI is badly inaccurate  for the locations I travel and setting bad data and that as default model is not working for me. Setting a weaker model an as default and requiring subscription to set a better one feels like a cynical money grab, I expected better from this otherwise great company. Beginning to look elsewhere.

reviews.title: Multiple features no longer work after update.
reviews.text: Update September 26, widgets no longer open the app correctly to your location it just opens the map, radar widget doesn’t open the radar layer. Forecast percentage accuracy no longer displays percentage just coloured dot where the colours are all similar so that’s useless.

reviews.title: Annoying Setting Options
reviews.text: Most of the interface is user friendly with the exception of one little red box at the bottom of the wind and temperature display. The box allows you to select things like which model you want to see, 1 hr vs 3 hr time increments. But the box auto closes constantly after barely enough time to focus on any of the words, let alone give your brain enough time to comprehend the information. There  is no reason this can’t be adjusted. But the developers answer to the same complaint on the app forum, is that they won’t fix it. I use that box constantly. So it annoys me enough to be a deciding factor on keeping the subscription. I’m looking for an alternate weather app for this reason alone. And the complete disregard for customers who point out the problem, is the reason I give it only two stars.

reviews.title: Weather radar used to be accurate, but not now
reviews.text: The weather radar on this app used to be spot-on to the minute and was brilliant for showing incoming downpours before walks. Alas in the last few months it has been inaccurate on every occasion in various places in the south of the UK. The weather radar doesn’t accurately reflect the weather at time of checking the app. I’m sure it’s great for other people, but alas I will be uninstalling it.

reviews.title: Doesn’t know where you are
reviews.text: Apparently this app does not know where you are when it starts. In fact, even when using the app there isn’t an easy way to immediately locate your position. In the settings, you set the app to use GPS, but this has no effect in the app when restarting or using it. To favorite a location you long press the location and a heart should show up per the instructions. This does not happen; Perhaps this is a paid feature. Although there is a “heart” to favorite a location in the hamburger menu, it doesn’t record the location and, there isn’t a list of favorites to select from later. Perhaps another paid feature. Not really useful as an application - but the particle movement entertains my cat.

reviews.title: Update is backwards step
reviews.text: Love this app and use it all the time, But the latest update doesn’t seem like a step forward. When you’re in a forecast you’re now presented with a Red bar and you can’t accurately pinpoint the hour to correlate the forecast in the wind direction. I’m not sure the arrows are updated as you scroll through the timeline either.

reviews.title: Clouds, are you there?
reviews.text: It’s possible I am just too stupid to work this out, but after 3 times making me give my fingerprint to ensure I’d pay up the rather massive £79.99 after the trial, the app asked me for my most important part of a weather app…. I picked clouds…. Then after a long wait while it configured my weather display (while it also tried to get me to touch my finger on a blistering £180 gold coloured special offer….),  I finally arrived at a crude weather map with no cloud layer in sight.  I clicked about for 10 minutes trying to find a cloud layer but just gave up in the end.

reviews.title: Ads Very Misleading
reviews.text: The ads say you can get a fishing map. I could not find it. Another user, EeyorePD, wrote a review complaining about the fishing map not being available in the app. The developer responded that what’s in the ad is what is being added to the app but the ads don’t say that. In fact, the ads show the feature being used. The guy who found NIkola went to prison for the same kind of misleading advertising. The developer also said that EeyorePD needed to reinstall the app and during the onboarding process to select Fishing and then Freshwater. I deleted the app from my phone retaining my subscription. I downloaded the app from the App Store. Fishing was not an option during the onboarding process so that was a lie in my opinion. Let’s see what kind of response I get.

reviews.title: Not a fan of the new update
reviews.text: You use to be able to see the 2 weeks forecast without it being greyed out. I preferred the premium logo over the screen with full colour. Just another example of an app getting to greedy and focusing more on profit than accessibility. Uninstalled - I can get a better app where I can see a full 2 weeks without it being disabled. Been using this app for years such a shame
